completion_evidence: DECIDED: CLOSED, with the reason recorded in PR #9. The lane declared claims/**, projections/**, tests/claims/** and docs/reasoning/** and shipped exactly two GitHub Actions workflows (165 lines) and nothing under any declared path. Those two workflows are not the lane's output but self-referential scaffolding intended to PRODUCE it: both trigger only on pushes to pg/claims-temporal-relations-20260806, gated on the literal commit message 'chore: stage Prompt 12 finalizer', and one of them opens the PR itself. Merging would land two permanently-dead workflows holding contents:write and pull-requests:write on main -- write permissions with no reachable trigger. The generation step never ran, so no claims or projections work exists to preserve. The DESIGN survives: the category-collapse diagnosis is on main via PR #6, and PG-P1-009 (lifespan overlap presented as contemporaneity) is a red-team case confirmed still reproducing by tools/verify_audit_findings.py. Branch preserved untouched.
